settings.mode: OpenCode CLI 2.2.5 non-interactive run from the isolated task workspace
settings.model_id: exact provider/model ID supplied at run time with --model
settings.isolation: read-only task files and solution.py-only edits; external directories and all shell commands denied; candidate code separately runs in the network-disabled Docker sandbox
settings.network: the agent CLI requires outbound HTTPS to the selected model provider; candidate execution has no network
settings.dynamic_permission_test: not performed; the pinned CLI resolves this policy without inference, while shell is denied and candidate execution is separately sandboxed

budget.cost_capture: documented $0 OpenRouter free-tier model served under the 50/day free-model quota; provider-reported token usage is recorded, estimated cost is $0, confirmed billing is not applicable (token budget raised from 60000 to 120000 after pilot attempt 4 showed a reasoning model exceeding 60000 tokens)

error_reasons: decode_error: raw count matches a sentinel code
conformity_indeterminate: missing corrected value or uncertainty
conformity_indeterminate: missing corrected value or uncertainty
units_error: unsupported conversion across unit categories
